_comment: Rename to .mcp.json and uncomment servers you need by removing the leading underscore from each key. Set tokens via env vars only — never inline.

_github_example._doc: GitHub MCP server. Requires: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var (PAT with repo + read:org).

_slack_example._doc: Slack MCP server. Requires: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN env var.

_linear_example._doc: Linear MCP server. Requires: LINEAR_API_KEY env var.

_postgres_example._doc: Postgres read-only MCP. Replace connection string. Use a read-only role.

_filesystem_example._doc: Filesystem MCP. Restrict to specific directories.
